recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If editors want to delete orphaned historical source files such as valueset-observation-relationshiptypes.xml, handle that as a separate build-scope/editorial cleanup rather than as the FHIR-7161 reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-7161 was a Published OO change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to remove unnecessary Observation.related.type complexity, especially the DSTU1 wording that a relationship type SHOULD be provided and that COMP/composed observations should not be displayed or interpreted without related observations.
initial_application: The original wording was removed during the 2015 Observation relationship work: commit 348f096acfd2c65b60b6ba759f214f756d403709 reintroduced Observation.component and removed the COMP/composed sentence from Observation.related.type, while commit 5ed5b573f8ed326eafc243d7c8981c87ad7818b1 explicitly tagged #7161 and edited Observation notes. Commit 5bdc6559670c09dbdcbfcdf5f716f84455c6e600 later remodeled Observation.related into Observation.hasMember and Observation.derivedFrom.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition defines Observation.hasMember, Observation.derivedFrom, and Observation.component, with no Observation.related/type element. The current Observation notes explain grouping through DiagnosticReport.result, Observation.component, Observation.hasMember, and Observation.derivedFrom. An orphaned historical valueset-observation-relationshiptypes.xml still contains COMP, but it is not referenced by current active source or published on build.fhir.org.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current spec already satisfies FHIR-7161 and no active source hunk is needed.

related_jiras.note: Referenced by FHIR-7161 as the grouping-notes context; current Observation notes reflect this guidance.
Part of the same Observation.related discussion that later separated derivation into Observation.derivedFrom.
Linked no-change issue about pulling out Observation.related.derivedFrom; comments document the relationship-model debate.
A later source cleanup already removed stale Observation.related summary text from the vital signs profile.
